fields.name: apiToken
fields.label: API token
fields.hint: In Todoist: Settings, Integrations, Developer, Copy API token. It is kept in this scene's settings on the frame, like a password.

fields.name: filter
fields.label: Filter
fields.hint: Which tasks to show, written as Todoist's filters are: "today | overdue" (the Today view), "7 days", "p1 | p2", "@errands", "#Home & today". One filter, no commas.

fields.name: project
fields.label: Project
fields.hint: Only the tasks of this project and its sub-projects: its name as Todoist shows it, or its link (open the project in Todoist on the web and copy the address). Leave it empty for every project.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.hint: Shown at the top. Left empty: "Today" for the Today view's filter, else the project or the filter.

options.label: Auto: high contrast where the panel shows no color

todoist.name: Todoist
todoist.description: Your Todoist tasks: what a filter finds (today and overdue by default), overdue first, each with its time, priority and project. Tap a ring to tick a task off.
